note: Kept only works whose recording I could tie to an RC number. Recorded but unmatched: Hathor Consort 'Fantasia No. 6' and 'Udite, lagrimosi spirti' (a 5); Private Musicke two fantasias a 4; Consort of Musicke a fantasia a 3, a 4, two 'Fantasia-Almand-Ayre' suites and three suites 'for 2 bass viols and organ'; Jacobean Ensemble/Thurston Dart suites Musica Britannica IX Nos. 98, 99 (one violin) and 102 (two violins). A booklet or the Charteris catalogue would let these be added. RC 101 and 104 numbers come from the Christ Church catalogue (VdGS 9 = RC 101, VdGS 12 = RC 104). RC 115: the Leonhardt recording says D major, Christ Church lists RC 115 in D minor and RC 116 in D major; the entry may be RC 116. Coprario's fantasia-suites are entered with organ as an obbligato part (formation 'other'): treating the organ as continuo would make the one-violin suites duos. The fantasia-suites recorded by Marq and Coolen use recorder for the violin part. Lyra-viol pieces kept as one set (Savall recorded six of eleven).
